value.body: A three-year postgraduate medical degree after MBBS in the diagnosis and treatment of mental illness — mood and anxiety disorders, psychosis, addiction, child and old-age psychiatry. Training combines in-patient and out-patient care, psychotherapy basics, emergency psychiatry and a thesis.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: MBBS with internship and registration, then NEET-PG (conducted by NBEMS). Seats are filled through MCC counselling for the all-India quota and through state counselling for state-quota seats.

value.title: At a glance
items: The large treatment gap means psychiatrists are needed in government hospitals, district mental health programmes and private practice.
Work hours are often more regular than in surgical specialties, though emotionally demanding cases and emergencies are part of the job.
Practice is shaped by the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017, which sets patient-rights and admission rules.
Fellowships (child, addiction, geriatric psychiatry) or a DM are possible next steps.
